---
name: documentation
description: Create or update repository README, technical documentation, plans, verification records, indexes, and wiki navigation.
---

Preserve established paths and casing. Keep tracked documentation canonical.

Write from current code and verified commands. Cover architecture, state flow, configuration, commands, APIs, compatibility, security, operations, verification, troubleshooting, and migrations that apply.

Update the root README, documentation index, technical overview, affected topic files, and wiki source links together. Do not advertise unmerged behavior.
